description: Verisk Analytics, Inc. is a leading data, analytics and technology provider serving clients in the insurance ecosystem, and using advanced technologies to collect and analyze billions of records it draws on unique data assets, insurance industry knowledge and technological expertise to provide valuable solutions that are integrated into client workflows, offering predictive analytics and decision support solutions to clients in rating, underwriting, claims, catastrophe, weather risk, and many other fields, in the United States and around the world helping clients protect individuals, communities and businesses. It completed the sale of its Energy business on February 1, 2023, and traces its history to 1971, when Insurance Services Office, Inc. started operations as a not-for-profit advisory and rating organization providing services to the U.S. property casualty insurance industry.
